Module com.sudoku
Package com.sudoku.model

Class SudokuValidator

java.lang.Object
com.sudoku.model.SudokuValidator
public class SudokuValidator extends Object
Provides all validation logic for a Sudoku board.

This class checks whether a number can legally be placed at a given position by verifying the three Sudoku constraints:

  1. No duplicate in the same row
  2. No duplicate in the same column
  3. No duplicate in the same 3×3 box

All methods are stateless and operate only on the provided Board reference, making this class safe to share across threads.

    • isValidPlacement

      public boolean isValidPlacement(Board board, int row, int col, int value)
      Determines whether placing value at (row, col) is valid.

      The check ignores the current value of the target cell, so it can be used both for new placements and for re-validation after a change.

      Parameters:
      board - the current board state
      row - the zero-based target row (0–8)
      col - the zero-based target column (0–8)
      value - the value to validate (1–9)
      Returns:
      true if placing value at (row, col) violates none of the three Sudoku constraints

    • isBoardValid

      public boolean isBoardValid(Board board)
      Checks whether the entire board is in a valid state according to all Sudoku rules.

      Empty cells (value == 0) are skipped during validation, so a partially filled board can still be valid.

      Parameters:
      board - the board to validate
      Returns:
      true if no row, column, or box contains duplicate values
